title: Harbison Installation Pounds on the Refrigerant Allowance (Repair and Emergency Service Calls)
content:
**Ruling.** On a completed Repair and Emergency Service Calls visit for a Comfort Club member, the refrigerant allowance takes account of a system Harbison installed. The record read is the customer's installation project under Replacement System Installations: whether a project is in closed status, and its closed date.

| Customer's Harbison installation project | Pounds added to the refrigerant allowance |
|---|---|
| Closed less than 120 whole months before the date of handling | 0.4 pound |
| Closed 120 or more whole months before the date of handling | 0.2 pound |
| No closed Harbison installation | Nothing |

In the words of the rule: a customer whose Harbison installation project was closed less than 120 whole months before the date of handling adds 0.4 pound to the refrigerant allowance pounds. One whose project was closed 120 or more months before adds 0.2 pound. A customer with no closed Harbison installation adds nothing. The pounds so added count toward the refrigerant allowance pounds before the pounds covered are taken.

## Boundary

- A project closed 119 whole months before the date of handling adds 0.4 pound.
- A project closed exactly 120 whole months before adds 0.2 pound.
- A project that is installed or inspected but not yet closed is not a closed Harbison installation and adds nothing.

## Example (hypothetical)

A member whose Harbison installation project closed 38 whole months before the date of handling adds 0.4 pound. A member whose project closed 150 whole months before adds 0.2 pound.
